title: Senior Backend Engineer - Core Payments
description:
Razorpay is looking for Senior Software Engineers to build next-generation payment infrastructure. You will design, build and operate distributed payment ledger services handling billions of dollars in volume.

Requirements:
- 4+ years of deep hands-on experience in Golang, Java, or Python.
- Strong expertise in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and caching (Redis).
- Experience with high throughput event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
- Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting microservices on Kubernetes and GCP/AWS.
- Deep understanding of distributed transactions, idempotency patterns, and p99 latency optimization.

title: Lead Software Development Engineer - Delivery Logistics
description:
Join Swiggy Logistics Platform engineering team. You will lead the architecture of real-time matching algorithms connecting millions of customers with delivery partners in sub-second latency.

Requirements:
- 6+ years in backend engineering building large-scale distributed systems in Go or Java.
- Strong expertise in distributed caching, geospatial indexing (H3, S2 geometry), and streaming data.
- Experience leading architectural decisions and mentoring junior/mid-level engineers.

title: Product Engineer - Frontend (Web & Mobile Web)
description:
CRED is looking for exceptional Product Engineers to build high-polish, buttery smooth user experiences. You will obsess over millisecond animations, web vitals, and frontend architecture.

Requirements:
- 3+ years experience with modern React, TypeScript, Next.js, and CSS animations.
- Deep knowledge of browser rendering pipelines, Web Vitals optimization, and state management.
- High aesthetic standard and eye for UI micro-interactions.
